fusions.name: Grapple and Hurl
fusions.desc: You clamp the target for 14 damage and fling it 3.5 tiles away, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Brawler's Roll
fusions.desc: You roll and pummel, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, with a 20% chance to leave each [Stunned] for 1 second. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Knuckled Retort
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and leaves them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Cornered Brute
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, your physical damage rises by 35% for 6 seconds, once every 30 seconds. Your armour is 5% higher at all times.
